brief: A potting station: two bins of soil, a carry handle on a cover, and a raised platform on a spike for a seed tray.

cover:0,0,0;full;top with handle:0,0,0;top mounted on it.

Seed tray prop prop:1 staged on bench beside build because props cannot stand on a spike (INVALID_INPUT on dryRun).
requirements.requirement: A raised platform on a spike for a seed tray

finish.summary: Potting station: 3 bases with two soil-filled bins, a covered cell with carry handle, and a mount spike with small platform (large clashed with bin rims). Seed tray staged on bench as props cannot mount on spikes. Caps and joint bolts applied; mesh clear.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
